context.problem_statement: Analyze adverse event rates between a Drug treatment group and a Placebo control group. For each of the five adverse events (nausea, headache, fatigue, dizziness, rash), perform a chi-square test of independence comparing event rates between groups. Apply Bonferroni correction for multiple testing (alpha = 0.05 / 5 = 0.01). Report the chi-square statistic, p-value, and event rates for each adverse event. Identify which adverse events are significantly more common in the Drug group.
context.expert_knowledge: Use scipy.stats.chi2_contingency with a 2x2 contingency table [event/no_event] x [Drug/Placebo]. Bonferroni correction controls family-wise error rate. Risk ratio = (event_rate_drug / event_rate_placebo) quantifies relative risk. Report both uncorrected and Bonferroni-corrected significance. Number needed to harm (NNH) = 1 / (rate_drug - rate_placebo).
